name: Candelaria Mining Corp.
summary: Candelaria Mining Corp. is dedicated to the strategic acquisition, exploration, and advancement of mineral properties throughout Mexico, with a primary focus on discovering gold and copper deposits. The company maintains full ownership of two key projects in the country: the Caballo Blanco project, situated in Veracruz state, and the Pinos gold project, located in Zacatecas state. Founded in 2012, the firm was known as Branco Resources Ltd. until it adopted the name Candelaria Mining Corp. in March 2016. Its corporate headquarters are based in Vancouver, Canada.
